subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository approve these 13 new executable Action revisions for the credentialed and security-sensitive workflows on the final rebased head?
rationale: Repository tests can validate OpenClaw workflow behavior, but accepting new third-party executable code that receives secrets or security artifacts requires owner trust judgment.

options.title: Approve the stable exact head
options.body: Review the upstream revisions, wait for exact-head checks, and merge the immutable pins if the security and automation contracts are acceptable.

options.title: Split or defer an action family
options.body: Pause the grouped update and isolate any action whose upstream changes or operational impact cannot be confidently approved.

recommendation.title: Approve the stable exact head
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revisions, wait for exact-head checks, and merge the immutable pins if the security and automation contracts are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the affected CI, Docker release, and Codex-agent workflows, with secops review still required for CODEOWNERS-protected files.
